nodes.html: In the primary industrial precincts of Welshpool, Kewdale and Osborne Park, commercial firms support the mining supply chain, fleet operations and manufacturing. These trade-heavy businesses require detailed advice on Fuel Tax Credits (FTC), Living Away From Home Allowances (LAFHA) and equipment depreciation write-offs. Perth remains a resilient, highly profitable region for commercial enterprise.

rows: HOW IT WORKS IN WESTERN AUSTRALIA
Applies once annual Australian wages exceed the $1 million threshold, with a diminishing deduction that effectively scales the rate up as wages grow toward $7.5 million.
Levied on investment property above the threshold; a foreign-owner surcharge applies.
Payable on property transfers; first-home-owner and other concessions may apply.
Employer premium based on wages and industry rate, reconciled annually.
